purpose: Test whether Stage104 quality losses arose because the Stage68 mean utility floor masked adverse scaffold-jackknife scenarios. Replace that mean floor with a fixed all-scenario quality constraint and minimize the same three-seed stable redundancy. This is a posthoc mechanism diagnosis, not a replacement-objective confirmation.

excluded_targets.MK14: The Stage68 stable-redundancy rule requires a complete three-seed score cube and frozen outer assignments in the Stage64 data interface. MK14 is not in that interface, so it is not silently approximated or added posthoc.

frozen_rule.stable_redundancy: R_ij=max(0,min_seed PearsonCorr(train-fitted receptor rank profiles)); only positive redundancy present in every docking seed is penalized.
frozen_rule.baseline: x0 is the full-outer-training pair-off top-k singleton-utility subset.
frozen_rule.scenario_quality_constraint: For every one of the four frozen scaffold jackknife blocks b, mean_i(u_i^(b) x_i) >= mean_i(u_i^(b) x0_i). The baseline x0 is feasible by construction.
frozen_rule.optimization: minimize stable redundancy subject to fixed cardinality and all four scenario quality constraints, using a SciPy HiGHS MILP certificate with exact pair-product linearization and zero requested MIP gap.
frozen_rule.future_encoding: This is a constrained binary model. Any future QUBO expansion must retain one slack equality per quality scenario and be audited separately; no penalty encoding is selected here.

evaluation.historical_outer_folds: reuse the four frozen Stage64 outer assignments
evaluation.phase_a_outer_folds: reuse the five frozen Stage102A manifest outer_fold assignments
evaluation.baseline: same-fold pair-off top-k singleton utility subset
evaluation.primary_metric: median-seed BEDROC alpha=20 using minimum rank across selected receptors
evaluation.robust_metric: (primary median-seed BEDROC + mean seed BEDROC + worst seed BEDROC) / 3

diagnostic_gate.interpretation: A pass would only motivate an independently reviewed, untouched-target protocol. It would not establish QUBO superiority, quantum execution, speedup, or quantum advantage.
